title: Interview: Retail Sales routing, capacity and English skill
story: You meet Tom, the retail sales manager, in a small meeting room. He wants to fix how incoming sales calls are offered to agents.
Tom explains there are wrong matches and long waits. He wants routing, capacity and English skill checks changed to match how his team works.

interview.opening: We need to improve how incoming sales calls are handled.

topics.ask: Do you want calls sent to whoever has been idle the longest, or someone who has most spare capacity?
topics.answer: Pick agents with the most spare capacity. I don't want to give another call to someone already stretched.

topics.ask: Should agents be allowed to handle more than one inbound sales call at once?
topics.answer: Yes. Let agents take two sales calls at the same time during busy periods.

topics.ask: Do incoming sales calls need a language or skill requirement?
topics.answer: Yes. Only agents who meet an intermediate level of English should be offered these sales calls. All three sales agents must meet that level.

extras.ask: Are the sales opening hours the usual office times?
extras.answer: Yes. The retail sales line is open weekdays from nine to five.

extras.ask: Do you want voicemail outside opening times?
extras.answer: Keep voicemail outside hours, that's fine.

extras.ask: Do we change the enterprise routing too?
extras.answer: No, leave the enterprise line as it is.
